content.text: In the pursuit of Crystal Palace's English winger Jesurun Rak-Sakyi, 22, who has an estimated value of £10 million, Rangers have entered the competition along with Sheffield United and Southampton.
St Johnstone are in talks for Caernarfon Town striker Louis Lloyd.
St Johnstone: Benjamin Kimpioka, striker; Nicky Clark, striker; Cammy MacPherson, midfielder; Barry Douglas, left-back.
